hab: Hangars too big for the plane
A hotel room with the curtains shut
bio: A gosling with dark rings round its eyes like flying goggles. It wants to go faster than anything has gone.
Its wings grew out of spruce. It is too big to fly more than once, and the once was enough to make the papers.
Its tail is a film reel and it keeps a studio under one wing and an airline under the other. It has not come out of the hangar in years.
note: Wants to be the fastest thing alive.
Washes its wings forty times a day.
